title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the old challenges and new commercial practices in the internal market
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘calls for further action in this sector to address the significant obstacles that persist, starting from setting ambitious targets in the upcoming single market strategy;’
part_context: Underscores that, as demonstrated by the Letta and Draghi reports, there is still untapped potential in the services sector; <del>calls for further action in this sector to address the significant obstacles that persist, starting from setting ambitious targets in the upcoming single market strategy;</del> notes that services account for three quarters of EU GDP, represent two thirds of employment and create 9 out of 10 new jobs in the EU economy; notes also, however, that services are still the least developed segment of the EU single market;
